table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	SupplierName = A.Name,
	ReturnNo=PR.PRInvCode,
	ReturnDate=PR.Date,
	Posted = PR.Posted,
	ReturnAmt = PR.InvTotal,
	Amt = PR.Amt,
	AllocationCode=H.PRAllocationCode,
	AllocationDate=H.Date,
	PurInvCode=D.PurInvCode,
	Pur_Amount = P.InvTotal,
	Pur_OutstandingAmt=D.OutStandingAmt,
	Pur_AllocatedAmt=D.Amt,
	Pur_Balance = D.OutStandingAmt - D.Amt,
	PR_Balance = PR.OutStandingAmt
FROM 
	PRAllocationHeader H, 
	PRAllocationDetail D, 
	PRLedger PR,
	PurLedger P,
	Accounts A
WHERE 
	PR.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	PR.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
	PR.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	PR.PRInvCode = H.PRInvCode AND
	H.PRAllocationCode = D.PRAllocationCode AND
	D.PurInvCode = P.PurInvCode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	SupplierName = A.Name,
	ReturnNo=PR.PRInvCode,
	ReturnDate=PR.Date,
	Posted = PR.Posted,
	ReturnAmt = PR.InvTotal,
	Amt = PR.Amt,
	AllocationCode=NULL,
	AllocationDate=NULL,
	PurInvCode=NULL,
	Pur_Amount = 0.00,
	Pur_OutstandingAmt=0.00,
	Pur_AllocatedAmt=0.00,
	Pur_Balance = 0.00,
	PR_Balance = PR.OutStandingAmt
FROM 
	PRLedger PR, Accounts A
WHERE 
	PR.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	PR.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
	PR.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	PR.PRInvCode NOT IN (SELECT PRInvCode FROM PRAllocationHeader)
ORDER BY
	SupplierName,
	ReturnNo,
	AllocationCode,
	AllocationDate

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: sum( returnamt  for all distinct  returnno) - sum( pur_allocatedamt for all)

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: sum( returnamt  for group 1 distinct  returnno) - sum( pur_allocatedamt for group 1)
